a: SAFE: salary said to be comparable to top US fellowships plus 150,000 RMB/yr research budget, 2 yr likely extended to 3; group postdocs 2 yr, extendable
e: Nine openings in Hangzhou: one independent SAFE Fellowship plus eight group postdocs (ISM modeling, microlensing exoplanets, JWST/ALMA extragalactic, planet formation theory, lensing/stellar evolution). Open to PhDs in physics, astronomy or related fields; no citizenship limits stated.
n: Westlake University: SAFE Fellowship and Postdoc Positions in Astronomy and Astrophysics
